prompt.text:
Implement an immutable walkthrough state model in Solution.java. Define a public final class Solution with a nested public static final class Walkthrough exposing List<String> getCards() and boolean isClosed(). Expose public static Walkthrough openWalkthrough(List<String> cards), public static Walkthrough closeWalkthrough(Walkthrough walkthrough), and public static boolean allVisible(List<Boolean> visibility). Card strings must be non-null and nonempty; invalid arguments cause IllegalArgumentException. An empty card list is valid. openWalkthrough must defensively copy the cards and create an open state. closeWalkthrough must return a new closed state without modifying or aliasing mutable caller data, including when its input is already closed. getCards must return an unmodifiable list. allVisible returns true exactly when every entry is true, including true for an empty list; null lists or null entries are malformed. No supplied collection may be mutated.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
